data.title: 新垣绫濑 · 晨光微熹的完美娇妻依偎
data.description: 初升暖阳穿透薄纱窗帘洒在纯白床褥间。绫濑侧躺在松软的羽绒被中，一头乌黑秀发在枕头间铺陈出优美弧度。轻薄睡裙的肩带滑落至手臂，露出纤细精致的锁骨与雪肌。刚刚醒来的美少女双眸含着晨曦的微光，伸手轻轻搭在空出的枕畔，向你展露出毫无防备、宛如完美新婚娇妻般甜美的微笑。
data.location: sunlit master bedroom with soft billowing white curtains
data.action: lying on side in bright white bed, delicate slip nightdress slipping off shoulder, dark hair spread on pillow, reaching hand gently toward viewer, radiant morning smile with sweet blush
data.lighting: warm golden morning sunbeams flooding the pristine white bedroom
data.mood: flawless matrimonial devotion, peaceful sunny morning warmth
data.promptProse: Lying on her side in bright morning sheets, Ayase Aragaki reaches a gentle hand forward from beneath the quilt. Her slip dress sits softly off one shoulder as she beams with flawless, wifely devotion.
data.animaCaption: Ayase waking up on white bedsheets with bare shoulders, smiling with tender wifely affection.
